  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  December 11, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, City Council Chambers, 9th
Floor. On December 11, 2025, at 2:01 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Managment Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on November 26, 2025

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Juan Medrano on behalf of WSS/ Eurostar to host an Inglewood Toy Giveaway Event at
  3000 W Century Blvd; Private Property; on Sunday, December 14, 2025 from 12:00 p.m.
  to 3:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for a one (1) day event within WSS
  parking lot; Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures; Approved; Applicant to hire two (2) police officers for public safety
  from 11 am-4 pm (5 hours) and eight (8) professional-licensed security guards for the safety
  of attendees and staff. This event shall be exclusively contained on private property—NO
  use of public streets, sidewalks, and alleys. The IPD watch commander will be notified and
  extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state and
  federal laws; None Code Enforcement conditions; None conditions for Fire Approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00416625)

Item #2:  Noemi Sanchez on behalf of Northgate Gonzalez Markets to host a Toy Giveaway Event
  at 10801 S. Prairie Ave.; Private Property; on Thursday, December 18, 2025, from 2:00

  p.m. – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for a one (1) day event within
  the Northgate Market parking lot. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up,
  and all applicable mitigation measures; Approved; Applicant shall ensure that traffic safety
  measures (plan) are in place for ingress & egress of vehicles where this event is expected
  to take place;There shall be NO vehicular traffic where customers will be walking in the
  area of this event; Applicant to hire a minimum of (2) professional-licensed security guards
  for the safety of attendees. Security staff shall wear traffic safety vests for visibility and risk
  management. IPD watch commander will be notified and extra patrol will be requested.
  Adhere to all local, state and federal laws.None Code Enforcement conditions; None
  conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00407278)

New Business License Renewal Request (s):
Item #3:  Suretta Small on Behalf of Humanistic Foundation, Inc. to operate as a Nursing/Healthcare
  Facility at 2406 W 78th St. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and tax fees;
  Applicant must have accurate employment records on all employees at all times;Not to
  exceed six (6) tenants/patients without a city approved Special Use Permit.Business owner
  and/or facility is subject to random inspection by any city, county, or state Police and/or
  Code Enforcement officers during hours of operation to ensure patient(s) good welfare,
  health and safety; Business owner/employer is responsible for maintaining accurate and
  updated employee records for all employee’s;Business owner/facility is strictly prohibited
  from hiring or employing any person registered under California Penal Code Section 290
  PC or any person that may pose a public safety risk/threat to patients or other employees
  at the location; andAdhere to all State, Federal, County Laws and Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of
  the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any
  future Business License application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00407322)

New Tobacco Retailer License Renewal Request (s):

Item #5:  Brian Kim, DBA Oasis Market, to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 544 W. Arbor Vitae St.
  This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition set forth by
  the Permits and Licenses Committee: Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal
  Codes (IMC), specifically, CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES
  ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and Federal
  Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25% of total retail floor
  areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes
  , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes;
 Permits & License Committee  December 11, 2025
Minutes  Page 4 of 5

  Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored
  Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers,
  Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor
  and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing
  tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid government-issued identification
  on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use,
  including hookah products; Sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords,
  knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business
  owners and/or new applicants or their designees are subject to random Permits & Licenses
  establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police or Code Enforcement
  Officers, purpose of random inspections is to enforce business establishments to adhere to
  the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for Community Public Health &
  Safety;California State Board of Equalization Tobacco Retailers license must be
  current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within existing business ONLY;NO sales
  of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to minors / underage persons. All persons
  purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products SHALL have a valid ID on their person
  at all times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;
  Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of
  the location; NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00407114)
